title: DirectiveSummary
description: The `summary` rule value exposed by each Rego module and aggregated by `_usda_policy_index.rego` into `all_summaries`. Provides a lightweight read-only projection of directive metadata plus coverage counts, suitable for dashboards and cross-directive search without loading full requirements arrays.

opi.description: Office of Primary Interest abbreviation or full name.

requirement_count.description: Total mandatory requirements in this module (≤75 for base file; part files add to the per-directive total).

section_count.description: Number of sections/appendixes extracted from the directive body.
